labctl.notes: HOST-NATIVE, no X: FS-UAE (github.com/Wnt/fs-uae, branch kernel-hive/integrated) runs on the host headless (no DISPLAY, no GL). Frames publish into SH_SHM_PATH (drawshm-format shm), keys and the absolute pointer (mousehack) ride the ctlsock (SH_MAMECTL_SOCK) with the shared streamhost/stations/fsuae-native/amiga.keymap, audio into SH_AUDIO_FIFO. No QEMU/QMP, no guest Linux, no exec channel, no Xvfb/XTEST. Reset=relaunch: fresh work disk(s) copied from disk/*.golden on every launch, cold boot, no statefile. Launcher stations/fsuae-native/x11-runtime.sh (shared with a1000/a3000; amigaos35/amix stay on the Xvfb+XTEST path, rule 13).

museum.arch: Motorola 68000 @ 7.16 MHz, OCS chipset (Agnus, Denise, Paula), 512 KB chip RAM
eraSoftware: Notepad, Clock and Say (the Extras disk)
museum.periodBrowser: none — the Amiga 1000 predates the web
iconicApps: Say, the speech synthesizer on the Extras disk
museum.blurb: The first Amiga: Commodore's 1985 desktop with custom chips for graphics, sound and disks, multitasking in colour when most personal computers ran one program at a time — and with the designers' signatures moulded inside the lid. It boots Workbench 1.2 from a floppy, as every A1000 did; on this model the Kickstart operating system came on a disk too.
museum.notes: Host-native without X: FS-UAE (fork github.com/Wnt/fs-uae, branch kernel-hive/integrated; A1000 model, OCS, 512 KB chip) runs headless -- shm frames, ctlsock keys/pointer, no Xvfb, no XTEST. Media: Kickstart 1.2 r33.180 ROM image + Workbench 1.2 rev 33.56 / Extras ADFs from archive.org (preservation-class, never committed). Reset = relaunch: a cold boot from fresh copies of the disks (~55 s to the desktop, measured on the prior Xvfb launcher). OPEN: the authentic Kickstart-from-floppy bootstrap (A1000 boot ROM + Kickstart disk in DF0) reset-loops in this FS-UAE build; shipped with the Kickstart 1.2 image in the ROM slot -- the shared fsuae-native launcher does not implement the bootstrap-ROM branch. Distinct from amiga (A500 / Workbench 1.3 bridge kiosk) and amigaos35 (A4000 / OS 3.5). See docs/guests/a1000.md.

reset.fixture: Workbench 1.2 desktop (blue, 640x256 PAL in a 720x568 window): RAM Disk + 'A500 WB 1.2' + Extras disk icons on the right, title bar 'Workbench release 1.2.  364736 free memory', no windows open. resetMode=relaunch with no statefile: every launch copies the pristine Workbench 1.2 and Extras ADFs into work/ and cold-boots. Measured on the golden stream 2026-09-09, first with amigaos35's fs-uae binary (station's own build not yet staged): desktop reached between +52 s (AmigaDOS banner still up) and +57 s (desktop with icons) after process start — consistent with the ledger's ~55 s. Repeated once the build stream staged the station's own binary (`/data/vms/streamhost/assets/a1000/fsuae-native/bin/fs-uae`, confirmed via /proc/<pid>/exe): identical desktop up by +55 s (ownbin_055.png) — golden + binary + device set is the proven combination for this station. Pointer PASS: XTEST mousedown+sleep 150ms+mouseup (NOT a bare xdotool click — an instant press+release was invisible to FS-UAE's mousehack poll every time it was tried) selects an icon on mousedown alone (frame proof: mdown.png, mup.png keeps the selection) and a 150 ms-hold/150 ms-gap double-click opens the 'A500 WB 1.2' disk window (dblclick.png, free memory 364736->364272) and its zoom gadget maximizes it to show the System/Utilities/Demos drawers (zoom.png). Keyboard: NOT PROVEN this run — double-clicking into System (system.png/system2.png, single click only registered, ran out of the 20-minute window before a second attempt) — no CLI/Shell was reached, so no typed-character proof exists yet. Reset PASS: kill by mame.pid + relaunch returns the identical pristine desktop (364736 free, no windows) in one more boot cycle (reset_desktop.png).
